notes: P53ccebd522 G4. Printed: 'When this creature enters, you may sacrifice another creature. When you do, destroy target creature an opponent controls.' Seat 0 controls no other creature, so nothing can be sacrificed and the reflexive 'When you do' trigger never happens (CR 603.12): the opponent's creature survives. The step carries no decisions: the engine asks nothing here (the may is not offered when no creature can be sacrificed), so any ask would raise and fail the pack.
